# Wish I Knew

> Build-in-public postmortems turned into stealable patterns.
> Site: https://wishiknew.lol

## Summary

Wish I Knew (wishiknew.lol) is an editorial feed of indie-scale launches and patterns — projects a solo builder could have shipped — framed as "what I wish I knew," plus concrete ship-this-week steps. No unicorn IDE / voice-lab tier. Heat is editorial among peers, not live MRR or virality APIs. Tone matches r/indiehackers and build-in-public culture.

## Primary pages

- / - Main feed (lessons + patterns), Wish I knew tip form, category filters
- /llms.txt - This file

## Product

- Audience: indie hackers, bootstrappers, AI builders, domain investors
- Core loop: browse ranked lessons -> expand "what I'd do differently" -> steal the pattern -> optionally Visit the product
- Contributions: "Wish I knew about..." tip form via Formspree (curated, not auto-published)
- Ranking: sorted by editorial heat (blazing -> steady), not a live virality API

## Affiliate note

Some Visit links are marked Affiliate when the product has a known partner program. Destination URLs may be official landers or tracked affiliate links. Commissions (if any) do not change the price for the buyer.

## Optional / archived

- Meme lab (regret to meme) exists in the codebase as an archived side mode; it is not linked from the main product UI.

## Contact

- Tips: on-site Wish I knew about... form
- Domain: wishiknew.lol
